1: Haa Meem. Aise huroof ke baare mein guftagu Surah Al-Baqarah mein guzar chuki hai.
2: Allah us Quran ki qasam khata hai jo haqq ki taraf hidayat ka raasta saaf bayan karta hai.
3: Beshak Hum ne Quran ko Shab-e-Qadr mein nazil kiya; woh bohat bhalai wali raat hai. Beshak Hum is Quran ke zariye darate hain.
4: Is raat mein rizq, umrein wagera se mutalliq har pakka maamla tay kiya jaata hai jo Allah us saal mein poora karne wala hota hai.
5: Main apna har pakka maamla tay karta hoon; beshak main hi hoon jo Rasool bhejta hoon.
6: Aey Rasool! Main Rasool apni rehmat se un logon ke liye bhejta hoon jin ki taraf woh bheje jaate hain. Beshak main, woh paak hai, apne bandon ki baaton ko sunne wala hoon, un ki niyyaton ko jaanne wala; un mein se kuchh mujh se poshida nahin.
7: Wahi aasmanon, zameen aur jo kuchh un dono ke darmiyan hai us ka Rubb hai. Agar tumhein is ka yaqeen hai to mere Rasool par iman lao.
8: Us ke siwa koi sachcha maabood nahin. Wahi zindagi deta hai aur maut deta hai; koi doosra nahin jo yeh karta ho. Wahi tumhara Rubb aur tum se pehle tumhare baap-dada ka Rubb hai.
9: In mushrikon ko is ka yaqeen nahin, balke woh is ke baare mein shubah mein hain aur us batil se, jis mein woh hain, apna dil bahlate hain.
10: Pas aey Rasool! Un ke us azaab ka intezar karein jo jald aayega: ek aisa din jab aasman khule tor par dhuen se bhar jayega.
11: Woh logon ko dhaank lega, aur un se kaha jayega: 'Yeh azaab jo tum par aaya ek dard-naak azaab hai.'
12: Phir woh apne Rubb se iltija karenge, us se maangte hue: 'Aey hamare Rubb! Woh azaab jo tu ne hum par bheja hum se hata de. Agar tu use hum se hata de to hum tujh par aur tere Rasool par iman le aayenge.'
13: Woh ab kaise nasihat le sakte hain aur apne Rubb ki taraf tauba kar sakte hain, jab un ke paas is se pehle ek khule Rasool aa chuke the, aur woh un ki sachchai aur amanatdari jaante the?
14: Unhon ne un par iman laane se munh pher liya, aur un ke baare mein kaha: 'Use sikhaya gaya hai. Doosre logon ne use sikhaya; woh Rasool nahin.' Unhon ne yeh bhi kaha: 'Woh deewana hai.'
15: Beshak jab Hum thodi der ke liye un se azaab hata denge to woh apne kufr aur jhutlane ki taraf laut jaayenge.
16: Aey Rasool! Us din ka intezar karein jab Hum kafiron ko sab se bari pakar se pakrenge, unhein Qayamat ke din Jahannam ki aag mein daakhil kar ke jahan woh hamesha rahenge. Hum un se un ke Allah ke saath kufr aur us ke Rasoolon ko jhutlane ka badla lenge.
17: Aur beshak Hum ne un se pehle Firaun ki qaum ko aazmaya, aur un ke paas Allah ki taraf se un ka izzat wala Rasool aaya jo unhein us ki wahdaniyat aur ibadat ki taraf bulata tha. Woh Moosa (alaihis salaam) the.
18: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne Firaun aur us ki qaum se kaha: 'Bani Israel ko mere hawale kar do, kyunke woh Allah ke bande hain; tumhein koi haqq nahin ke unhein ghulam banao. Beshak main tumhari taraf Allah ki taraf se Rasool hoon, main us ke pahunchane mein amanatdar hoon jis ke pahunchane ka us ne mujhe hukm diya. Main us mein se kuchh kam na karoonga aur na kuchh barhaoonga.'
19: 'Aur Allah ke muqable mein takabbur na karo us ki ibadat chhod kar aur us ke bandon par bartari ka daawa kar ke. Beshak main tumhare paas ek khuli daleel laaoonga.'
20: 'Aur main ne apne Rubb aur tumhare Rubb ki panaah maangi hai is se ke tum mujhe sang-saar kar ke qatl kar do.'
21: 'Agar tum us par iman na lao jo main laaya hoon, to mujhe yakta chhod do; nuqsan ke irade se mere qareeb na aao.'
22: Phir Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne apne Rubb se dua ki: 'Yeh qaum, yani Firaun aur us ki qaum, ek mujrim qaum hai jo jald azaab ke haqqdaar hain.'
23: Pas Allah ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko hukm diya ke woh apni qaum ko raat mein le jaayein, aur unhein bataya ke Firaun aur us ki qaum un ka peecha karenge.
24: Us ne unhein yeh bhi hukm diya ke jab woh sab samandar paar kar lein to use waise hi khada chhod dein jaise woh tha, kyunke Firaun aur us ki qaum us mein doob kar halak hone wale the.
25: Firaun aur us ki qaum kitne hi baagh aur behte chashme peeche chhod gaye!
26: Aur kitne hi khet aur khoobsoorat jagahein woh peeche chhod gaye!
27: Aur aish ki kitni hi zindagiyan jo woh guzarte the, woh peeche chhod gaye!
28: Jo tumhare saamne bayan hua woh un ke saath hua, aur Hum ne ek doosri qaum, yani Bani Israel ko un ke baagon, chashmon, kheton aur imaraton ka waris banaya.
29: Na aasmanon ne Firaun aur us ki qaum par roya aur na zameen ne jab woh doobe, aur na unhein tauba ke liye mohlat di gayi.
30: Aur beshak Hum ne Bani Israel ko zillat wale azaab se bacha liya, kyunke Firaun aur us ki qaum un ke bachche qatl karte the aur un ki auraton ko zinda rakhte the.
31: Hum ne unhein Firaun ke azaab se bacha liya. Beshak woh un logon mein se ek takabbur karne wala tha jo Allah ke hukm aur deen se aage barh gaye.
32: Aur beshak Hum ne Bani Israel ko jaan boojh kar apne zamane ke logon par chun liya, un ke bohat se Ambiya ki wajah se.
33: Aur Hum ne unhein aise mu'jize ata kiye jin ke zariye Hum ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko quwwat di, aur jin mein un ke liye ek zaahir barkat thi, jaise Mann aur Salwa aur doosri cheezein.
34: Beshak yeh jhutlane wale mushrik, dobara uthne ka inkar karte hue, kahenge:
35: 'Hum sirf apni pehli maut marenge; us ke baad koi zindagi nahin, aur hum is maut ke baad dobara uthaye jaane wale nahin.'
36: 'Aey Muhammad ﷺ! Agar tum apne is daawe mein sachche ho ke Allah murdon ko badle aur hisaab ke liye zinda uthayega, to hamare un baap-dada ko zinda kar do jo mar chuke hain.'
37: Aey Rasool! Kya yeh jhutlane wale mushrik zyada taqatwar aur zyada mazboot hain, ya Tubba ki qaum aur un ke baad wale jaise Aad aur Samood? Hum ne un sab ko halak kar diya. Beshak woh mujrim the.
38: Aur Hum ne aasmanon, zameen aur jo kuchh un ke darmiyan hai use khel aur tamashe ke liye paida nahin kiya.
39: Hum ne use sirf ek gehri hikmat ki wajah se paida kiya, lekin bohat se mushrik yeh nahin jaante.
40: Qayamat ka din, jis mein Allah bandon ke darmiyan faisla karega, tamam makhlooq ke liye woh muqarrar waqt hai jis mein Allah unhein jama karega.
41: Woh din jab koi rishtedaar apne rishtedaar ko faida na de sakega aur na koi dost apne dost ko, aur na woh Allah ke azaab se bachaye jaayenge, kyunke us din iqtidar sirf Allah ka hoga. Koi us ka daawa na kar sakega.
42: Siwaye us shaks ke jis par Allah reham kare, kyunke woh us nek amal se faida uthayega jo us ne aage bheja. Allah zabardast hai jis par koi ghalib nahin aa sakta, apni takhleeq, faisle aur tadbeer mein hikmat wala.
43: Zaqqoom ka darakht jise Allah ne aag ki tah mein ugaya,
44: woh un sakht gunahgaron ka khana hai jo us ke ghinoone phal khayenge!
45: Kaale tel ki tarah, un ke peton mein apni shadeed garmi ki wajah se khaulta hua.
46: Nihayat garam paani ke khaulne ki tarah.
47: Jahannam ke daroghon se kaha jayega: 'Use pakro, use zabardasti aur sakhti se aag ke beech ki taraf ghaseeto.'
48: 'Phir is shaks ke sar par, jise azaab diya ja raha hai, garam paani daalo, taake azaab us se alag na ho.'
49: Us se mazaaq ke tor par kaha jayega: 'Is dard-naak azaab ka maza chakho. Tum hi woh zabardast ho jis ke saath na-insaafi nahin ki jaati, apni qaum mein izzat wala.'
50: 'Yeh woh azaab hai jis ke Qayamat ke din hone mein tum shubah karte the, lekin ab use dekh kar tumhara shubah tum se hat gaya.'
51: Jo log apne Rubb se darte hain, us ke ahkam baja laa kar aur us ki mana ki hui cheezon se ruk kar, woh ek aisi rehne ki jagah mein honge jo har us museebat se mehfooz hai jo unhein pahunch sakti ho.
53: Woh Jannat mein baareek aur dabeez resham pehenenge. Woh ek doosre ke saamne honge aur ek doosre ki gardan ka peechla hissa na dekhenge.
54: Jaise Hum unhein us se nawazenge jo bayan hua, isi tarah Hum Jannat mein un ka nikah un khoobsoorat auraton se karenge jin ki aankhein badi aur khoobsoorat hongi.
55: Woh wahan apne khidmat-guzaron ko bulayenge ke un ke paas har woh phal laayein jo woh chaahein, jo khatm hone se aur apne nuqsan se mehfooz hain.
56: Us mein hamesha rehte hue. Woh us mein maut ka maza na chakhenge siwaye duniya ki zindagi ki pehli maut ke, aur un ka Rubb unhein aag ke azaab se bacha lega.
57: Aap ke Rubb ki taraf se un par fazl aur meharbani ke tor par, aey Rasool. Jo bayan hua, yani unhein Jannat mein daakhil karna aur unhein aag se bachana, woh badi kaamyabi hai jis se koi kaamyabi barabar nahin.
58: Hum ne yeh Quran aap ke liye aasan kar diya aur use suhula bana diya, use aap ki Arabi zuban mein nazil kar ke, aey Rasool, taake woh nasihat lein.
59: Pas apni madad aur un ki halaakat ka intezar karein; woh aap ki halaakat ka intezar kar rahe hain.
